subject: visual-visibility
text: - Nodes with `display: none` or `visibility: hidden` or carrying `inert`, and their descendants, are excluded from the accessibility tree, and so from the snapshot — a select's option excepted from `display: none` (§4 Hidden content), so a select's options are under it in the tree and the snapshot, directly or through an `optgroup`, the exception holding under a group (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:131-134); a hit answers nothing at an element carrying `inert`, before any other test, so a hit passes through it, and removing `inert` restores the tree and the hit (the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:19-28; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:281-301; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1450-1459; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:104-363); a hit also skips a node dropped since the last resolve (architecture §Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree)
